description: Election Commission - Declare that H. G. L. Sarath Kumara as a member of the Rambukkana P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a newly elected member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
